name: RPG battles
author: ct
description: Glue of the rpg world with turn-based battles, mounted only in a game that has both: random encounters on the steps of a map (its Encounters field) and the rpg.battle action, a battle that returns to the map cell and can set a win flag. Without turn_battle_base the world walks, collides, talks and teleports, and nothing starts a battle. Holds no content and no save data.
